description: Recommended agent path. Request a signed, citable statement for a SHA-256 (sit-statement/0.1). Same as the signed-out curl: curl -s -X POST https://soulintime.com/functions/createMoment -H "Content-Type: application/json" -d '{"sha256Hash":"<64 hex>"}'. First one free, no account; one fresh hash per network per hour. Creates an unlisted hash-only receipt. Once Bitcoin confirms the hash, the result carries the full statement {v,sha256,status:"confirmed",block_height,block_hash,ots_sha256,issued_at,issuer,kid,sig}, a one-line cite ("sha256 <hash> existed by Bitcoin block <N>. Statement: <url>"), export_url, proofFile (.ots), the three offline steps and "This still verifies if we disappear.": paste the cite line as-is. While pending it returns statement: null and a wait note: pending is not a statement. Already stamped or rate limited answers are HTTP 429 with reason already_stamped or rate_limited: not a statement; no retry. Optional client: your tool or client name (self-declared, stored internally; nothing else about you is stored). No file upload. Need more than the free rate? See https://soulintime.com/pricing.
name: stamp
